text:
incident-bot: PAGER: genqueue 5xx spike detected in eu-west-1 — paging oncall (priority: P1)

Dave_oncall: Ack. Looking now.

alice: seeing elevated 500s and a cluster of timeouts in the genqueue pool, tailing logs and metrics (cpu, req latency).

bob_ops: Drafting status page copy below. Need a quick legal check before publish — ETA 10m.

carol_prod: Quick customer impact summary: affects text generation + streaming in EU-west-1. Some long-running streams drop. No evidence of data loss so far.

legal_sa: Quick note: avoid SLA language. Suggest 'intermittent failures' instead of 'degradation' and don't speculate on percent of customers without confidence.

bob_ops: Initial draft (for internal review):

---
Initial update — Investigating (EU-west-1)
Time: 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z
Impact: Intermittent failures and increased errors for text generation and streaming for a subset of requests in EU-west-1. Some requests may return HTTP 500 or time out.
Scope: A subset of EU-west-1 customers and requests.
Customer guidance: Retry requests. We are routing traffic and enabling fallbacks where possible.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new information.
---

legal_sa: Replace 'subset' with 'a subset' is fine. Suggest adding 'no data loss' only if we confirm — leave out for now. Also change 'Intermittent failures' -> 'partial service interruptions' to be precise.

bob_ops: Updated draft with legal changes:

---
Initial update — Investigating (EU-west-1)
Time: 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z
Impact: Partial service interruptions and elevated error rates for text generation and streaming for a subset of requests in EU-west-1. Some requests may return HTTP 500 or time out.
Scope: A subset of EU-west-1 customers and requests.
Customer guidance: Retry requests; customers with regional routing can switch to EU-central or US-west to mitigate availability impact.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new information.
---

carol_prod: +1. Can we add a one-line mitigation note about routing fallback being available for critical customers?

Dave_oncall: We have a regional fallback policy in place. I'll confirm routing health before publish and we can include 'routing fallback available' if green.

alice: found correlated symptom: NLB healthchecks flapping against genqueue workers due to CPU spikes from KV cache eviction. Investigating config rollback or cache throttle.

bob_ops: OK. We'll publish the initial update now with the current text and include routing fallback note pending confirmation.

dave_oncall: Publishing now. I'll post statuspage link when live.

incident-bot: :rocket: Status update published: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-345 — Initial update posted.

carol_prod: Nice. Reminder: schedule next update in 30m and call out any mitigation progress.

bob_ops: Reminder set (30m). If we have resolution earlier we'll post an intermediate update.

alice: proceeding with KV cache config rollback on a canary. Will report progress and metrics.

legal_sa: LGTM on the published text.

end.
